cues.en: Congratulations.
cues.zh: 恭喜。

cues.en: You just got hired at Keiko Corp..
cues.zh: 你剛被 Keiko Corp 錄取。

cues.en: They're the latest Silicon Valley startup to hit the scene.
cues.zh: 這是最新崛起的矽谷新創。

cues.en: They help analyze data of large companies and consult on what companies should do with their data.
cues.zh: 他們協助大型公司分析資料，並提供如何運用資料的顧問服務。

cues.en: They do autonomous vehicles, security cameras.
cues.zh: 做自駕車、監視攝影機。

cues.en: They have an online dating app, a website.
cues.zh: 有線上交友 App 和網站。

cues.en: They even have drones.
cues.zh: 甚至有無人機。

cues.en: And they also offer their services like Amazon, to other big companies or startups.
cues.zh: 也像 Amazon 一樣，向其他大公司或新創提供服務。

cues.en: And you just got hired.
cues.zh: 你剛被錄取。

cues.en: Awesome.
cues.zh: 太好了。

cues.en: Wait, what is your role?
cues.zh: 等等，你的職務是什麼？

cues.en: Well, you're the new machine learning and data science expert.
cues.zh: 你是新任機器學習與資料科學專家。

cues.en: Well, this is a little awkward because you don't really know anything about that, do you?
cues.zh: 有點尷尬，因為你其實完全不懂，對吧？

cues.en: Maybe a little bit, maybe you've heard it in the news, but this is going to be awkward because it's too late.
cues.zh: 也許懂一點，也許在新聞聽過，但現在很尷尬，因為太遲了。

cues.en: You're already hired and people want you working right away.
cues.zh: 你已經被錄取，大家希望你立刻開始工作。

cues.en: So you entered the office and.
cues.zh: 你走進辦公室。

cues.en: Oh, there's your boss right there.
cues.zh: 喔，主管就在那裡。

cues.en: This guy over here with the perfect hair.
cues.zh: 就是這個髮型完美的傢伙。

cues.en: That's Bruno.
cues.zh: 他叫 Bruno。

cues.en: He just got promoted, and he's really excited to make an impact with KeyCorp in their data division.
cues.zh: 剛升遷，迫不及待想在公司的資料部門做出影響。

cues.en: And he just hired you to lead some of their initiatives.
cues.zh: 他剛聘請你，領導一些新計畫。

cues.en: Now.
cues.zh: 現在，

cues.en: He seems nice on the surface, but I have a feeling that he's going to be a tough cookie to work with.
cues.zh: 他表面上很親切，但我覺得和他共事可能不容易。

cues.en: But you know what?
cues.zh: 不過你知道嗎？

cues.en: We'll get through this.
cues.zh: 我們能一起度過。

cues.en: Now, if your memory is fuzzy of how you ended up here at Cake Corp, let's not worry about that.
cues.zh: 如果記不清怎麼來到這家公司，先別擔心。

cues.en: It's your first day on the job.
cues.zh: 今天是第一天上班。

cues.en: All you know is that you're the new machine learning and data science expert now because this is your first day.
cues.zh: 你只知道自己是新任機器學習與資料科學專家；既然是第一天，

cues.en: As you do, you go out for lunch with your coworkers and luckily they don't ask you too many questions and they seem to like you.
cues.zh: 就像一般新人，和同事出去吃午餐，幸好他們沒問太多問題，而且似乎很喜歡你。

cues.en: They seem to be nice.
cues.zh: 他們看起來都很親切。

cues.en: But then during lunch comes the question.
cues.zh: 但午餐時，問題來了。

cues.en: Hey, we've heard about this machine learning thing, and Bruno said that you're the expert on the topic and we're excited to have you on the team.
cues.zh: 「我們聽過機器學習，Bruno 說你是這方面的專家，很高興你加入團隊。」

cues.en: But what is machine learning?
cues.zh: 「但機器學習到底是什麼？」

cues.en: And you think to yourself, Oh, boy, what should I say here?
cues.zh: 你心想，糟了，該怎麼回答？

cues.en: Well, you know what, guys?
cues.zh: 「各位，你們知道嗎？」

cues.en: I have to go back to work.
cues.zh: 「我得回去工作了。」

cues.en: Don't have much time.
cues.zh: 「時間不多。」

cues.en: I'll explain it to you tomorrow.
cues.zh: 「明天再解釋。」

cues.en: So you run away.
cues.zh: 你就逃跑了。

cues.en: Still confused how you got here.
cues.zh: 還是搞不清楚自己怎麼來到這裡。

cues.en: But luckily the day ends with you not revealing that you know absolutely nothing and you have no idea how you just got hired.
cues.zh: 幸好這天結束時，還沒暴露自己完全不懂，也不知道怎麼被錄取。

cues.en: You survived the first day, but we have a problem, right?
cues.zh: 撐過第一天，但現在有個問題，對吧？

cues.en: Tomorrow you have to go into work and you're going to have to explain this to your colleagues.
cues.zh: 明天上班，必須向同事解釋。

cues.en: Hopefully can survive throughout the next couple of weeks and let people know that you're not an impostor.
cues.zh: 希望能撐過接下來幾週，讓大家知道自己不是冒牌貨。

cues.en: But, hmm.
cues.zh: 不過，嗯。

cues.en: What should we do here?
cues.zh: 該怎麼辦？

cues.en: Well, luckily for you, you remember your old childhood friends.
cues.zh: 幸好想起兒時老朋友。

cues.en: Their name?
cues.zh: 他們叫什麼？

cues.en: Andre and Daniel.
cues.zh: Andrei 和 Daniel。

cues.en: Look how cute they were as a baby.
cues.zh: 看看他們小時候多可愛。

cues.en: You call them up and you say, hey, somehow I landed this job in Silicon Valley.
cues.zh: 你打電話說：「不知道怎麼回事，我找到一份矽谷的工作。」

cues.en: It's really well paid, but I have no idea what I'm talking about.
cues.zh: 「薪水很好，但我完全不知道自己在說什麼。」

cues.en: And luckily for you, they know.
cues.zh: 幸好他們懂。

cues.en: So they're going to help you throughout this journey to make sure that Bruno doesn't fire you and you impress all your colleagues.
cues.zh: 所以會一路協助，確保 Bruno 不會開除你，而且讓同事印象深刻。

cues.en: What we're going to do is each day at work, you're going to get some tasks and then you're going to go back home.
cues.zh: 接下來每天上班，你會收到一些任務，然後回家。

cues.en: And Andre and Daniel are going to help you so that.
cues.zh: Andrei 和 Daniel 會協助你，讓你，

cues.en: Well, you don't get fired.
cues.zh: 不會被開除。

cues.en: So.
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: Here we are, all of us at home trying to decide how we're going to tackle this first problem.
cues.zh: 大家現在一起在家，想想怎麼解決第一個問題。

cues.en: That is what is machine learning.
cues.zh: 也就是機器學習是什麼。

cues.en: We have to go into work tomorrow and explain it to our colleagues.
cues.zh: 明天要去上班，向同事解釋。

cues.en: Let's get to it.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: What is machine learning?
cues.zh: 什麼是機器學習？
